name: Tsunamis
overview: Scripture reveals God's sovereign control over the natural world, including powerful forces like stormy winds and roaring waves, as seen in Psalms 107:25 and Luke 21:25. These turbulent events, such as tsunamis, serve as reminders of divine authority and the unfolding of His purposes, even amid distress and judgment, as indicated in Zephaniah 2:5. Believers are assured that God's plans are for peace and an expected end (Jeremiah 29:11), and while the timing of such events remains known only to the Father (Matthew 24:36), they ultimately point toward the fulfillment of His redemptive work (Daniel 9:24).
